description: Convert an amount between a crypto and a fiat currency, or between two crypto assets, at the current spot price: the rate, the converted amount, the pair path used (direct, or through USD) and the time of the rate. Spot prices from Coinbase, Kraken as the fallback. A spot rate, not an executable quote: no fees or slippage. Fiat to fiat is refused; use the FX tool for that. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

amount.description: Positive amount in the from currency, up to 12 decimals (default 1)

from.description: Symbol to convert from: BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC or a fiat code such as EUR

to.description: Symbol to convert to, e.g. EUR, USD or ETH

name: crypto_convert
title: Crypto Convert
